{{Infobox auto}}

'''Glow berry crumble''' is the meal of [[Glow Berries|glow berries]]. It heals {{Value|Glow Berry Crumble|heals}} and grants the Aura intrinsic for 1 minute, making every other creature within 50 blocks glow.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/glow_berry_crumble.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Glow Berry Mash|Glow berry mash]], sugar, a [[Milk Bottle|milk bottle]] and dough. Obtaining glow berry mash unlocks the recipe. Crafting it gives back the milk bottle's glass bottle.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Glow Berry Crumble|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Glow Berry Crumble|heals}}. A bell sound plays, and 2.4 seconds later every other entity within 50 blocks glows for 1 minute.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/effects/aura/60s.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
